status: Native major brush settings/preset workflow implemented and tested. Full B01/Photoshop parity remains open.
scope: Modeless Brush Settings/Brushes, sampled tips, shape/scatter/color/transfer/texture/dual-tip dynamics, smoothing/pose/symmetry/airbrush, actual canvas preview and one-step painting history, native/ABR preset transport, shared Photato automation and recorded strokes.

source_provenance.upstream: PhotoCraft Rust snapshot; MIT OR Apache-2.0, unmodified
source_provenance.native: Counter-based RNG/dab/coverage design translated to Swift. Some procedural textures/tips are native approximations; no Adobe preset pixels bundled. Legacy nil-settings Brush values retain the original painter.

photato_api.state: Full active brush settings, selected preset ID, library metadata/revision and active gesture; recursive strict parameter schema and busy/stale/sharing guards.
photato_api.limits: API command4MiB, preset import base64<=3000000characters,4096points; desktop100000points. Core200000dabs,134217728rastervisits; each sparse coverage map<=128MiB. Preset file64MiB,512presets,48MiBbitmap aggregate; a brush16MiBbitmap aggregate. Tip/texture edges<=2500 and diameter<=2048.

adobe_api.status: Published execute-actions brush resources and brush/path action descriptors remain unsupported. Existing routes continue to reject unqualified fields/descriptors. No dedicated freehand endpoint is present in the pinned contract. ABR transport support does not imply Firefly job compatibility.
adobe_api.next: Qualify real brush/path descriptors and job-local ABR resource binding, preserving asynchronous job semantics. Do not invent descriptor shapes from the UXP method signature.

persistence: Native brush library version1; advanced recorded brush actions require version2 and preserve immutable settings/tablet/seed data. Pixel edits use existing native32 archives. Legacy v1 actions remain readable; downgraded advanced actions reject.

tests.independent: Analytical opacity/flow and geometry assertions plus literal ABR v1 computed fixture. Modern ABR and native preset round trips are self-generated, not independent Photoshop interoperability proof.
tests.ui: Offscreen SwiftUI layout and synthetic AppKit canvas gestures only. No new live desktop test; latest desktop evidence remains locked.

limitations: No byte-identical Photoshop rasterization claim; procedural texture, antialias/mipmapping and high-depth/HDR brush precision need independent qualification.
Generated bristle stamp is not a physical bristle/wet-media simulation; Mixer Brush is next.
Complete ABR versions/fields, brush organizational UI details and large-file API transfers remain open. Unsupported fields are reported; missing samples/patterns reject affected presets.
Adobe execute-actions brush resources and descriptors are not implemented in this increment. Full B01 acceptance remains open.
Native event capture exists but physical tablet, live Photoshop and macOS14/Intel/macOS26 platform checks remain unqualified.
API inline preset file limits are narrower than desktop; imported files do not silently truncate.
Preview uses completed full-document snapshots, coalescing pointer events to avoid starvation; incremental dirty-region performance remains open.
Painting on nonraster content currently rejects; current Adobe documentation describes automatic creation of a transparent paint layer. Carry this major workflow dependency into B02.
next: B02 missing major painting tools: Pencil, Mixer Brush, Color Replacement, Pattern Stamp, Background Eraser and Magic Eraser, each with shared APIs/history and focused tests. Exact numerical/cosmetic refinements stay deferred.
qualification: All 103 focused Debug and 1834 full optimized tests pass. The universal macOS 14+ package verifies.
